component.name: BrightTable
component.summary: Connect an Immich library to external RAW editors

description.p: BrightTable is a desktop viewer for Linux, connecting a self-hosted Immich photo library with open-source RAW editors (ART, RawTherapee, darktable) into a single round-trip workflow: browse your library, send a RAW to an external editor, and have the edited result picked back up automatically.
